# Micah 5 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 5:4 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-he-will-stand and-shepherd in-the-strength-of YHWH, in-the-majesty-of the-name-of YHWH his-God; and-they-will-dwell, for now he-will-be-great to-the-ends-of the-earth. |
| LOGOS | And He shall stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD His God. And they shall dwell secure, for now He shall be great to the ends of the earth. |
| PNEUMA | And He will stand and lead His flock with the LORD's strength, in the majestic name of the LORD His God. His people will live there undisturbed, for He will be highly honored around the world. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 5:6 (overlap: 9%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men. |
| LOGOS | The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man. |
| PNEUMA | The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like dew from the LORD, like refreshing showers on the grass — not dependent on anyone, waiting for no one. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
